definitions.full: H151. Adoram אֲדֹרָם (contracted or corrupt, compare foregoing) same official, under David 2Sam 20:24 , & Rehoboam 1Kin 12:18 (= הֲדֹרָם 2Chr 10:18 ).

occurrences.englishText: Adoram was over the men subject to forced labor, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the recorder,

Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and all Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
